name: Open Science Workflows Building Blocks
abstract: Building Blocks for FAIR Open Science - profiles of OGC API Processes and various metadata standards to support open, transparent, interoperable and reproducible scientific workflows..
description: This repository is initially aimed to support the [Open Science Persistent Demonstrator](https://www.ogc.org/initiatives/open-science/) pilot, but may be further developed as a set of standards with appropriate working group governance.

bblocks.name: HARTIS CVI Workflow Provenance
bblocks.abstract: A provenance profile for the complete HARTIS Coastal Vulnerability Index workflow, from configuration and source data through coastline extraction, transect generation, indicator calculations and the final CVI result.
bblocks.description: This HARTIS D100 candidate profiles a complete workflow execution rather than a generic single processing step. It makes the workflow definition, planned processing activities, runtime activities, used entities and generated entities explicit so that the full CVI chain can be reviewed and reproduced.

bblocks.name: Model of Models workflow
bblocks.abstract: Tested provenance example of a slice of the RSS-Hydro Model of Models flood workflow: per-watershed aggregation of a gridded source, hazard score accumulation with extra model inputs, and the final alert from the hazard scores of all sources. GFMS and GloFAS are example sources.

bblocks.name: Open Science profile of OGC API Processes
bblocks.abstract: Support reproduceable science and interoperable workflows through profiling OGC API Processes to use a workflow model with transparent provenance and adherance to a common metadata profile for describing data inputs and outputs.
